methods.analysis_precision: float64; aligned kernels and inputs unchanged

methods.season_year: middle month calendar year; all three months inside slice; calendar-day weighted rates
methods.seasonal_precipitation_parity_exception: percentages use mean rates; lab uses totals
methods.precipitation_cv: detrended SD of period integrals divided by integral mean
methods.detrending: OLS on actual retained year coordinates; residual SD ddof=0
methods.degenerate_variability: raw SD for raw statistics; own detrended SD for ratios; no floors; zero future ratio reported but excluded from logarithmic reductions
methods.weights: equal model; eligible member weight 1/eligible members in model for pooled log quantiles
methods.agreement_interpretation: model and family sign counts; bands are display heuristics, not likelihoods
